title: 戴尔营收增速：从个位数跳至48%，AI基建需求能否持续？
speaker: Mandip Singh

segments.en: Well, all these companies were growing, you know, mid to high single.
segments.zh: 这些公司过去增速都在中高个位数。

segments.en: They did at best top line growth and suddenly, you know, because everyone is looking to upgrade their infrastructure to run more AI workloads.
segments.zh: 营收增长最多也就那样，但突然之间，大家都在升级基础设施以运行更多AI工作负载。

segments.en: Company like Dell is guiding to almost, you know, 48% top line growth.
segments.zh: 像戴尔这样的公司，营收增长指引接近48%。

segments.en: And yes, they are, you know, benefiting from a new line of AI servers, which didn't exist two, three years back.
segments.zh: 是的，它们受益于两三年前还不存在的AI服务器新产线。

segments.en: You know, when you look at the size of these companies and the way they were growing in the past decade.
segments.zh: 看看这些公司的体量和过去十年的增长方式。

segments.en: And now suddenly, you know, everyone is talking about sustaining that double digit growth.
segments.zh: 现在突然之间，大家都在谈论如何维持两位数的增长。

segments.en: That's what's driving a reset and expectation.
segments.zh: 这就是预期重置的驱动力。
